newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $611 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $611 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday are expected to total $611 million in 19 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $308 million in six sales, with a $260 million N.Y. State Thruway Authority issue through Goldman Sachs & Co. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 13 sales totaling $304 million are on the schedule. A $185 million Nassau County, N.Y., deal at 1200 EST is the largest.
An additional three sales totaling $207 million are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Thursday, depending on market conditions.
